description: This file defines a React component for a user interface that provides various methods to connect to MCP (Model Context Protocol) clients, including integrations with OpenAI, LiteLLM Proxy, Cursor IDE, and Streamable HTTP. It includes UI elements, code snippets, and configuration options for setting up these connections.

classes.name: CodeBlockProps
classes.description: Props for the CodeBlock component, including code snippet, title, copy key, and optional class name.

classes.name: FeatureCardProps
classes.description: Props for the FeatureCard component, including icon, title, description, children, server name, and access groups.

classes.name: MCPConnectProps
classes.description: Props for the main MCPConnect component, including optional current server access groups.

methods.name: getHeadersConfig
methods.description: Generates headers configuration for MCP requests, including API key and optional server and access group headers.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to clipboard and manages success state for UI feedback.

methods.name: CodeBlock
methods.description: Component that displays a code snippet with a copy button, supporting optional title and styling.

methods.name: StepCard
methods.description: Component that displays a step in setup instructions with a number, title, and content.

methods.name: LiteLLMProxyTab
methods.description: UI tab content for LiteLLM Proxy API integration, including setup instructions and code snippets.

methods.name: OpenAITab
methods.description: UI tab content for OpenAI API integration, including setup instructions and code snippets.

methods.name: CursorTab
methods.description: UI tab content for Cursor IDE integration, including setup instructions and configuration code.

methods.name: StreamableHTTPTab
methods.description: UI tab content for Streamable HTTP transport, including connection details and documentation link.
